The sweetness of the ingredients give this risotto a mild flavor.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Vegetable Risottos are made by [[Cooking]] [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], [[Rock Salt]], and either a [[Fortified Pumpkin]] or any [[Carrot]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version is made by using [[Ingredient]]s with contradicting [[Added Effect]]s. [[Link]] can eat them to heal some of his [[Heart]]s. Due to this [[Meal]]'s sweetness, it has a mild flavor. Based on the type of [[Vegetable]] used, Link can make the following variations of Vegetable Risotto: * '''Enduring Vegetable Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Vegetable Risotto}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The sweetness of the ingredients gives this risotto a mild flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Carrot]]s. By eating them, Link can restore and overfill his [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Vegetable Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Vegetable Risotto}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The sweetness of the ingredients gives this risotto a mild flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Swift Carrot]]s. They can be eaten to grant Link a boost to his movement speed. * '''Tough Vegetable Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Vegetable Risotto}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The sweetness of the ingredients gives this risotto a mild flavor.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Fortified Pumpkins. When eaten, these risottos will increase Link's [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} [[Link]] can make Vegetable Risottos by [[Cooking]] a variety of [[Carrot]] or [[Pumpkin]] with [[Goat Butter]], [[Hylian Rice]], and [[Rock Salt]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for Vegetable Risotto is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[The Yiga Clan Attacks!]]". It is made using two [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s, two [[Hylian Rice]], two [[Goat Butter]]s, and two [[Rock Salt]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to one. [[Cooking]] Vegetable Risotto before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] temporarily increases the [[Warrior]]'s maximum [[Health]] by one. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Vegetable Risotto Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Vegetable Risotto icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Risottos |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
